_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only; OPS-257. Proposal only: nothing is applied by the tooling.
RFC 6902 operations below are relative to the existing merge_queue rule's parameters. The tool resolves the rule index; never replace the whole rules array with this file.
Read and preview: gh api --method GET repos/inspr-at/paimos/rulesets/$RULESET_ID > /tmp/ops257-ruleset-before.json; node scripts/ci-queue-measure.mjs --ruleset $RULESET_ID --dry-run
Operator apply (not executed by this tool): gh api --method PUT repos/inspr-at/paimos/rulesets/$RULESET_ID --input /tmp/ops257-ruleset-after.json
Refresh the snapshot and recheck the diff immediately before any operator PUT. Full PUT/rollback bodies preserve this snapshot, so concurrent ruleset edits require a fresh plan.
Preserves merge_method, grouping_strategy, check timeout, required checks, enforcement, conditions and bypass actors. No HEADGREEN relaxation is proposed.

max_entries_to_merge=5 limits merges, not CI builds: GitHub documents that merge limits do not combine merge_group builds. min=1 avoids deliberately waiting to fill a group; wait=1 is only a fallback if min later increases.
